steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: A series of exercises performed one after another at different stations. Each station targets a different muscle group or fitness component, with a set time or number of reps at each station, followed by a short rest before moving to the next. | Definition: Exercising at a steady, moderate intensity for a sustained period without rest breaks. The heart rate is maintained at 60-80% of maximum heart rate throughout the session. | Definition: "Speed play" - a form of continuous training where the intensity varies throughout the session. The performer alternates between fast and slow running (or other activities) over varying terrain, without structured rest periods. | Definition: Alternating periods of high-intensity exercise with periods of rest or low-intensity recovery.
